prompt: An accepted ADR and current implementation disagree about ownership. A proposal suggests a third option. Investigate the supplied repository. Reuse any supplied contract IDs. The declared design depends on a shared store, but the inspected code uses process-local state; explain the dependency distinction and operational uncertainty without claiming runtime verification.

criteria.description: Cite relevant sources and distinguish accepted decision, proposal, observed behavior and inference.
Surface the discrepancy and practical consequence without inventing an ADR or resolving authority silently.
Keep search bounded to supplied/linked repositories.
Reuse supplied source/constraint IDs, retain declared versus observed dependency provenance and operational evidence gaps; no role-specific state or fabricated execution.
